entities.name: El Gecko
entities.description: An artist who painted the Art Lizard.

entities.name: Art Lizard
entities.description: A lizard brought to life out of a drawing by magical means; the only known art creature.

events.summary: The artist El Gecko paints an Art Lizard that appears to be brought to life out of a drawing by magical means.
events.quote: It appears to be a lizard brought to life out of a drawing by magical means.

relations.note: El Gecko painted the Art Lizard.
relations.quote: The only known art creature is that of an Art Lizard painted by an artist known as El Gecko.
